steps.name: staged-static-gates-and-targeted-hardware-regressions
steps.command:
set -eu
test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "1984a7b464a7ab07c28c480be04b5f9168860be9"
test -z "$(git status --porcelain)"
echo TARGET_PRODUCT_SHA;git rev-parse HEAD
echo PRECHECK_LOAD;uptime
echo CHECK_STATIC
pnpm check:static > /tmp/shelly-ionic-175-static.log 2>&1 || { echo STATIC_FAILED;tail -100 /tmp/shelly-ionic-175-static.log;exit 72; }
echo CHECK_STATIC_PASS
tail -24 /tmp/shelly-ionic-175-static.log
echo FOCUSED_BLE_SETTINGS
pnpm --filter @lcl/mobile exec vitest run src/__tests__/hardware-setup.test.tsx --reporter=default > /tmp/shelly-ionic-175-hardware.log 2>&1 || { echo BLE_FOCUSED_FAILED;tail -85 /tmp/shelly-ionic-175-hardware.log;exit 73; }
echo BLE_FOCUSED_PASS
tail -21 /tmp/shelly-ionic-175-hardware.log
echo POSTCHECK_LOAD;uptime
echo WORKTREE;git status --short
